$comment: LICENSE-PENDING — see docs/non_ratified/LICENSE_PENDING.md. loop-release.v1 is a CLIENT-SIDE / STATIC-REGISTRY artifact only. Per the master build brief's hard scope boundary and LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md's header ('this build-out does NOT build a hosted marketplace service, accounts, reviews, or moderation storage'), this schema does NOT describe a database row or a service this repo runs — it describes one entry of the signed JSON index in the public Git registry repository that §11 defines as 'THE DEFINITION of the marketplace for this build-out': 'The index lists releases by loopId, semanticVersion, package-content digest, publisher key fingerprint, and a download URL. The index itself is signed; a client verifies the index signature before trusting any entry in it.' The release's .floop bytes themselves live on the publisher's own GitHub Release (§11), never Fonebrew-hosted. FB-RAT-PKG-006 (immutable once published) + FB-RAT-MKT-003 ('referenced releases are immutable content-addressed artifacts, distinct from the mutable listing that references them' — see loop-listing.schema.json). The {loopId, semanticVersion, packageDigest, publisherKeyFingerprint} tuple below is LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §14's release identity, quoted verbatim: 'A release is identified by {loopId, semanticVersion, packageDigest, publisherKeyFingerprint}. The digest is the final source of byte-level identity.' NOTE (flagged, not silently reconciled): §14 names this field 'packageDigest'; the sibling files in this corpus (loop-package-manifest.schema.json, loop-package-signature.schema.json, floop-container-format.v1.json) name the identical SHA-256-over-canonicalized-semantic-files concept 'packageContentDigest'. This schema uses 'packageDigest' because that is the literal field name the task brief for this document specifies and the literal word §14 uses — the same digest, two literal spellings across sibling ratified documents. Worth reconciling editorially in a future pass; not a semantic conflict, and not resolved here (no new decision ID needed — this is a naming-drift observation, not a content dispute).
title: LoopRelease
description: loop-release.v1 — one entry of the signed static/Git-backed registry index (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §11). Immutable and content-addressed: the release identity tuple (loopId, semanticVersion, packageDigest, publisherKeyFingerprint) MUST NOT change once published (FB-RAT-PKG-006, FB-RAT-MKT-003). This schema cannot itself enforce non-mutation over time — that is a registry-repository (Git history / PR review) obligation, not a single-document structural property; §11's realization is that any change to these four fields is, by definition, a DIFFERENT release, published as a new index entry, never an edit of this one. The only fields on an already-published entry that MAY be updated in place via a follow-up PR are the revocation fields below, which mark trust status, not content (§10's KEY_REVOKED mapping: 'A revoked: true / revokedAt field set directly on the affected index entries via PR; a client checks this field locally at browse/download/update time — no push notification, no revocation service.').

loopId.description: Stable human/version identity of the loop family (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §2), independent of packageDigest's exact-content identity. Part of the release identity tuple (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §14).

semanticVersion.description: SemVer 2.0.0 string. Part of the release identity tuple (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §14, LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §12).

packageDigest.description: The package-content digest LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §14 calls 'the final source of byte-level identity' — the same SHA-256 value floop-container-format.v1.json's packageContentDigest computes (over the JCS-canonicalized (normalizedPath, byteLength, sha256) tuple list for every semanticFile packageInventory entry, NOT raw archive bytes). See this schema's top-level $comment for the packageDigest/packageContentDigest naming-drift note.

publisherKeyFingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the publisher's Ed25519 public key, lowercase hex — the fourth element of the release identity tuple (LOOP_ENGINEERING_SPEC_V2.1.md §14) and the key-revocation lookup key (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11, LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §6).

releaseAssetUrl.description: Download URL for the release's .floop bytes, hosted on the publisher's OWN GitHub Release — never Fonebrew-hosted user content (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §11: '.floop package assets hosted on publishers' own GitHub Releases — never Fonebrew-hosted user content. Fonebrew's registry repository holds only the index and metadata; the bytes of every package live on infrastructure the publisher, not Fonebrew, controls and is responsible for.'). This schema checks URL shape only; that the host is actually the declared publisher's own GitHub Releases infrastructure (not a Fonebrew-controlled or unrelated third-party host) is a build/import-time integrity check, not a structural property a JSON Schema can express — see this schema's adversarial/ fixtures.

publishedAtUtc.description: UTC instant this index entry was published (i.e. the submission PR merged — 'Merge is publication; the PR and its review are the audit trail — nothing extra is stored,' LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §11).

signatureRef.description: Pointer to the detached loop-package-signature.v1 record (loop-package-signature.schema.json) proving this release's identity tuple was signed by the key at publisherKeyFingerprint, per LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11 (FB-RAT-PKG-005). Co-hosted with releaseAssetUrl on the publisher's own GitHub Release (§11) — not a separate Fonebrew-hosted signature store. This schema does not re-embed the full signature record inline (loop-package-signature.schema.json already owns that shape); a client MUST fetch and verify it before trusting this release, including checking whether keyProvenance is PHONE_KEYSTORE (the only tier eligible for marketplace publication, LOOP_WEB_STUDIO_SPEC.md §13) — see this schema's adversarial/ fixtures for the schema-valid-but-ineligible case this pointer indirection cannot catch by itself.

releaseChannel.description: The distribution channel this release was published under (e.g. 'stable', 'prerelease') — the same non-empty-string, non-enum vocabulary loop-package-signature.schema.json's releaseChannel uses, since it is the value bound into that same signature (LOOP_PACKAGE_SPEC.md §11). Null when the publisher declares no channel; a referencing loop-listing.v1 (loop-listing.schema.json) MAY reference a stable and a pre-release channel simultaneously (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §4).

revoked.description: Trust-status flag, not content — set true via a follow-up PR against the registry repository when the signing key at publisherKeyFingerprint is revoked (LOOP_MARKETPLACE_CONTRACT.md §10's KEY_REVOKED, realized at §11 as exactly this field). MUST NOT be read as retroactively deleting or invalidating bytes already installed locally (§6: 'Key revocation marks affected releases; it MUST NOT retroactively delete local copies already installed.') — only as 'do not newly trust/activate under this key going forward.'

revokedAtUtc.description: UTC instant revocation was recorded. Required non-null exactly when revoked is true — see this schema's allOf.

signatureAssetUrl.description: URL to the detached signature record's bytes, co-hosted with releaseAssetUrl on the publisher's own GitHub Release (§11) — not modeled as an archive-relative 'signatures/' path (unlike loop-package-manifest.schema.json's SignatureRef) because this object lives outside any .floop archive, in the registry index.

sha256.description: Digest of the signature file's own bytes, for integrity-on-fetch — distinct from the signedDigest carried inside the signature record itself (loop-package-signature.schema.json).
